project_type: .NET 8 WPF worship presentation app (OWC / WorshipBacktrackPlayer). Core class library + WPF Presenter (net8.0-windows) + xUnit test project. SQLite persistence via a shared app.db.
build_system: dotnet / MSBuild. Solution: WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. Projects: WorshipPlayer.Core (net8.0), WorshipPlayer.Presenter (net8.0-windows, WPF), WorshipPlayer.Tests (net8.0, xUnit), plus WorshipPlayer.Audio/UI. Quirk: the Presenter project is net8.0-windows and CANNOT be referenced by the Tests project, so Tests references Core only and <Compile Include> links specific Presenter service .cs files when it must test them. WPF UI is NOT unit-tested headless.
test_framework: xUnit 2.6.6 (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0, xunit.runner.visualstudio). Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 8.0.0 available in Tests for direct-DB assertions.
build_command: dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln  (per-project: dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Core\WorshipPlayer.Core.csproj ; dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Presenter\WorshipPlayer.Presenter.csproj)
verification_instructions: 1) dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Core for the helper. 2) dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests for the Core unit tests. 3) dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Presenter for the WPF editor + wiring (XAML must compile). 4) dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln + dotnet test for full integration. key_patterns: Modal editor window: a Window that merges OwcDesignSystem.xaml, Background=#0F1117, WindowStartupLocation=CenterOwner, hosts content, bridges Save/Cancel to DialogResult + Close() (see SongMetadataEditorWindow.xaml.cs). Opened with Owner=Window.GetWindow(this) / Owner=this, ShowDialog(), act on DialogResult==true (see SlidesLibraryPanel.AddSlides_Click opening SlideNameDialog). Async _Click handlers call the service then Refresh(). Service UpdateAsync persists the WHOLE object (slides+order), re-stamps UpdatedAt and re-derives SlideCount; the UI never writes those columns. GetByIdAsync returns a fresh deserialized object (safe to treat as an editable copy). Tests use a temp app.db via the service ctor and SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() in Dispose to allow temp-file deletion on Windows.
